patthana15.70:1.1: araṇaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ,
patthana15.70:2.1: saraṇaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ,
patthana15.70:3.1: araṇaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. araṇaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā dve, avigate dve,
patthana15.70:5.1: araṇo abyākato dhammo na araṇassa abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. araṇo abyākato dhammo na saraṇassa abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.
